targets.query: SELECT "State of Charge" FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE ("Name" = 'SBMS0a') AND $timeFilter
SELECT ("PV Total Current" * "Battery Voltage") / 3600 / 1000 FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE $timeFilter
SELECT ("Battery Current" + ABS("Battery Current"))/2 * "Battery Voltage" / 3600 / 1000  FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE $timeFilter
SELECT (-"Battery Current" + ABS("Battery Current"))/2 * "Battery Voltage" / 3600 / 1000  FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE $timeFilter
SELECT "Battery Voltage" * ("PV Total Current"-"Battery Current") / 3600 / 1000 FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE $timeFilter
SELECT "Battery Voltage" * "PV Total Current" FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE ("Name" = 'SBMS0a') AND $timeFilter
SELECT "Battery Voltage" * "Battery Current"   FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE ("Name" = 'SBMS0a') AND $timeFilter
SELECT "Battery Voltage" * ("PV Total Current"-"Battery Current") FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE ("Name" = 'SBMS0a') AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("Monitor Flags") FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE ("Name" = 'SBMS0a') AND $timeFilter
SELECT  (315 *(100 - "State of Charge")  / 100) /  (("Battery Current" +ABS("Battery Current")) / 2 ) * 60 FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE ("Name" = 'SBMS0a') AND "Battery Current" > 0 AND $timeFilter

SELECT  (315 *(100 - "State of Charge")  / 100) /  (("Battery Current" +ABS("Battery Current")) / 2 ) * 60 FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE ("Name" = 'SBMS0a') AND "Battery Current" > 0 AND time > now() -15m
SELECT  (315 *(100 - "State of Charge")  / 100) /  (("Battery Current" +ABS("Battery Current")) / 2 ) * 60 FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE ("Name" = 'SBMS0a') AND "Battery Current" > 0 AND time > now() -1h
SELECT  (315 * "State of Charge" / 100) / ((-"Battery Current" + ABS("Battery Current"))/2 ) *60 FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE ("Name" = 'SBMS0a') AND "Battery Current" < 0 AND $timeFilter

SELECT  (315 * "State of Charge" / 100) /  ("PV Total Current"-"Battery Current") / 2 * 60  FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE ("Name" = 'SBMS0a') AND ("PV Total Current" - "Battery Current") > 0 AND time > now() -1h

SELECT  (315 * "State of Charge" / 100) /  ("PV Total Current"-"Battery Current") / 2 * 60  FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE ("Name" = 'SBMS0a') AND ("PV Total Current" - "Battery Current") > 0 AND time > now() -24h

SELECT "Cell 1" AS "Cell1", "Cell 2" AS "Cell2", "Cell 3" AS "Cell3", "Cell 4" AS "Cell4", "Cell 5" AS "Cell5", "Cell 6" AS "Cell6", "Cell 7" AS "Cell7", "Cell 8" AS "Cell8" FROM "raw_1s"."SBMS_Metrics" WHERE ("Name" = 'SBMS0a') AND $timeFilter
SELECT min("Cell Delta") * 1000 FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE ("Name" = 'SBMS0a') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1m) fill(previous) ORDER BY time DESC
SELECT "PV Total Current" * "Battery Voltage" FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE ("Name" = 'SBMS0a') AND $timeFilter
SELECT ("PV Total Current"-"Battery Current") * "Battery Voltage" FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE ("Name" = 'SBMS0a') AND $timeFilter
SELECT "Battery Current" * "Battery Voltage" FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE ("Name" = 'SBMS0a') AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("Battery Voltage") FROM "raw_1s"."SBMS_Metrics" WHERE ("Name" = 'SBMS0a') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT last("State of Charge") FROM "raw_1s"."SBMS_Metrics" WHERE ("Name" = 'SBMS0a') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT ("Internal Temperature") FROM "SBMS_Metrics" WHERE ("Name" = 'SBMS0a') AND $timeFilter
